name: Qualys VMDR
summary: Qualys VMDR combines asset inventory, scanning with agents, sensors and scanners, TruRisk-based prioritization and built-in patching and ticketing. Qualys publishes no prices and has a 30-day free trial, so budgets start with a sales call.

facts.text: Qualys says VMDR finds known and unknown assets on premises, in the cloud and facing the internet, and lists unlimited virtual scanners, cloud agents, passive sensors and container sensors.
Qualys's TruRisk scoring uses threat intelligence from more than 25 sources. The product page does not name CISA KEV.
VMDR can generate ITSM tickets automatically and assign them using Qualys tags, and it names ServiceNow and Jira integrations.
Qualys offers VMDR free for 30 days and directs pricing questions to sales.
